en.headline: Restaurant, Bar & Café Hong Kong trade show opens at HKCEC
en.dek: The three-day F&B expo runs until Thursday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, featuring more than 400 exhibitors, coffee competitions and bar awards.
body: The Restaurant, Bar & Café Hong Kong trade exhibition opened on Tuesday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, running until 3 September.

Organised by Informa Markets, the event brings together more than 400 exhibitors and brands covering meat and seafood, green products, coffee, spirits, equipment and technology. Opening hours are 11am to 6.30pm on Tuesday and Wednesday, and 11am to 5pm on Thursday. Admission is free for trade visitors aged 16 or above.

Programme highlights include the Hong Kong Best Bars Awards, which received a record of more than 90 entries, the Hong Kong Coffee Challenge, and an Eco-Innovation Hub focused on sustainable products. The organiser said the show aims to connect hospitality, food retail and sustainability sectors.

zh.headline: 香港餐飲展於會展開幕 展期至周四
zh.dek: 為期三天的餐飲貿易展於灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，匯聚逾400個參展商，設咖啡競賽及酒吧大獎。
body: 香港餐飲展（Restaurant, Bar & Café Hong Kong）周二於灣仔香港會議展覽中心開幕，展期至9月3日。
由Informa Markets主辦的展覽匯聚逾400個參展商及品牌，涵蓋肉類海鮮、綠色產品、咖啡、烈酒、設備及科技等範疇。開放時間為周二及周三上午11時至晚上6時半，周四上午11時至下午5時，16歲或以上業界人士免費入場。
節目重點包括接獲破紀錄逾90個申請的香港最佳酒吧大獎、香港咖啡競技大賽，以及聚焦可持續產品的Eco-Innovation Hub。主辦方表示展覽旨在串聯款待、食品零售及可持續發展領域。
